text: To reset your password, open Settings, choose Security, click Reset Password, and follow the emailed link.
At checkout we accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
Standard shipping typically arrives within five to seven business days after dispatch.
Once your order ships, a tracking number is emailed to you and shown on the Orders page.
Enable two-factor authentication in Settings under Security by adding an authenticator app or phone number.
You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.
Yes, the mobile app includes a dark mode you can turn on under Appearance in Settings.
Update your billing address in Settings under Billing, then save the new address before your next charge.
You can cancel your subscription at any time from the Billing page; access continues until the end of the paid period.
Reach customer support through the in-app Help center or by emailing support@example.com for a reply within one business day.
Download past invoices from the Billing page under Invoice History as PDF files for any prior period.
New users get a 14-day free trial with full access; no charge is made until the trial ends.
Adjust which alerts you receive in Settings under Notifications, toggling email and push options independently.
If a payment fails, we retry it after three days and email you a link to update your card before suspending access.
Permanently delete your account from Settings under Privacy by choosing Delete Account and confirming; this removes your data.
Yes, we ship to most countries; international orders may take ten to fifteen business days and incur customs fees.
Enter your discount code in the Promo Code field on the checkout page and click Apply before paying.
Upgrade to a higher plan from the Billing page; the new rate is prorated and takes effect immediately.
Your payment details are encrypted and stored with a PCI-compliant processor; we never see your full card number.
Your full order history, including past and current orders, is listed on the Orders page in your account.
